title_sq: Shitet apartament 2+1 te ali demi, kompleksi Kadiu!
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1, siperfaqe 70.3 m2, kati 5, gati per banim ne dhjetor 2025 te kompleksi Mangalem, faza Kadiu. Aartamenti ka ne planimetri te regullt e te mireshfrytezuar. 
Pagesa eshte me 2 keste: 80% me lidhjen e kontrates, 20% me dorezimin e celsave. 
Apartamenti dorezohet me dyer, dritare, grila, laminat dhe tualet i kompletuar me hidrosanitare inkaso.
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in ali demi, Kadiu complex!
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale, surface area 70.3 m2, 5th floor, ready for occupancy in December 2025, Mangalem complex, Kadiu phase. The apartment has a regular and well-used layout. The payment is in 2 installments: 80% with the conclusion of the contract, 20% with the delivery of the cells. The apartment is delivered with doors, windows, shutters, laminate and a toilet complete with a flush toilet.
